basic_information.title: Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Marketplace with Dynamic Pricing and Recommendation Engine
basic_information.summary: A robust e-commerce platform allowing multiple vendors to sell products, featuring an AI-driven recommendation engine for buyers and dynamic pricing tools for sellers.

abstract: The transition from single-seller online stores to multi-vendor marketplaces introduces significant complexities in inventory management, pricing strategies, and user personalization. This project presents a scalable multi-vendor e-commerce platform. For buyers, the system includes a personalized recommendation engine that analyzes browsing history and purchase behavior to suggest relevant products. For sellers, it offers a dynamic pricing module that adjusts product prices automatically based on competitor pricing, stock levels, and historical demand. The platform ensures secure payment processing and provides comprehensive dashboards for both vendors and platform administrators to track sales, commissions, and logistics.
problem_statement: In a crowded e-commerce landscape, small vendors struggle to optimize their pricing competitively, and buyers are often overwhelmed by choice, leading to low conversion rates and poor vendor retention.

primary: Develop a multi-tenant backend architecture supporting independent vendor storefronts.
Implement a collaborative filtering recommendation engine for personalized product discovery.
Create a dynamic pricing algorithm for vendors to automatically adjust prices.
secondary: Integrate a secure payment gateway with split-payment capabilities for vendor commissions.
Provide analytical dashboards for vendors to monitor sales performance.

included: Vendor registration and product catalog management.
User cart, checkout, and order tracking.
Recommendation algorithms based on user behavior.

features.name: Vendor Dashboard

features.description: Automatically modifies prices within vendor-set limits based on market demand signals.

modules.name: Order and Payment Module

frameworks.purpose: Server-side rendered frontend for SEO and performance.

algorithms.name: Rule-based Pricing Algorithm
algorithms.purpose: Adjust prices based on inventory levels and competitor scraping data.

reasons: Requires handling complex relational data with multi-tenancy.
Financial transaction management and split routing.

phase_breakdown.phase: System architecture and core API development

expected_outcomes: A functional recommendation engine improving simulated conversion rates.
A dynamic pricing tool that successfully maximizes simulated vendor revenue.
limitations: Recommendation engine suffers from the cold-start problem for new products/users.
Dynamic pricing requires reliable external data sources which may be brittle.
future_scope: Incorporate NLP for semantic product search and chatbots.
Add augmented reality (AR) features for product previewing.
Implement a robust fraud detection system for transactions.
